mapper.select: SELECT a.sys40_bookmark_id AS bookmark_id , a.sys40_company_id AS company_id , a.sys40_person_id AS person_id , a.sys40_menu_id AS menu_id , a.sys40_parent_title_nm AS parent_title_nm , a.sys40_seq AS seq , f_menu_nm_allpath(b.sys06_menu_id) AS menu_nm FROM sys40_bookmark a INNER JOIN (SELECT a.* FROM sys06_menu a , sys07_role_menu , sys05_user_role , sys03_company_menu WHERE sys07_use_yn = 'true' AND sys06_menu_id = sys07_menu_id AND sys07_role_id = sys05_role_id AND sys06_menu_id = sys03_menu_id AND sys05_user_id = #{userId} AND sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys06_parent_id != 0 AND sys06_parent_id NOT IN (SELECT sys06_menu_id FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_parent_id = 0) UNION SELECT a.* FROM sys03_company_menu , sys04_role , sys06_menu a , sys07_role_menu WHERE sys07_use_yn = 'true' AND sys04_default_role = 'true' AND sys04_company_id = sys03_company_id AND sys03_menu_id = sys06_menu_id AND sys04_role_id = sys07_role_id AND sys06_menu_id = sys07_menu_id AND sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys06_parent_id != 0 AND sys06_parent_id NOT IN (SELECT sys06_menu_id FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_parent_id = 0) ORDER BY sys06_parent_id, sys06_seq) b ON b.sys06_menu_id = a.sys40_menu_id WHERE a.sys40_person_id = #{userId} AND a.sys40_company_id = #{companyId} AND f_menu_nm_allpath(b.sys06_menu_id) LIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY COALESCE(a.sys40_parent_title_nm,''), a.sys40_seq, b.sys06_parent_id, menu_nm

SELECT a.sys40_bookmark_id AS bookmark_id , a.sys40_company_id AS company_id , a.sys40_person_id AS person_id , a.sys40_menu_id AS menu_id , a.sys40_parent_title_nm AS parent_title_nm , a.sys40_seq AS seq , NULL::text AS menu_nm FROM sys40_bookmark a WHERE a.sys40_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.sys40_person_id = #{userId} AND a.sys40_menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys40_bookmark (sys40_bookmark_id, sys40_company_id, sys40_person_id, sys40_menu_id) VALUES (nextval('bookmarkseq'), #{companyId}, #{userId}, #{menuId})
